explanation: Click probability alone is easy to learn but rewards clickbait headlines, which hurts long-term engagement. Combining a click model with a "quality after the click" model (read time, or a "read more than 30 seconds" label) is how production rankers handle it: a multi-task model predicts several engagement signals, and a value function combines them. The weights are a product decision tuned online. A weekly count is not a per-article ranking signal, and clustering ignores the individual user.
